title: Person: Mr Dedalus
html_source:
This passage is marked in the Open Editions semantic edition as a person name.

Mr Dedalus

anchor.prefix:
e got a good breath of ozone round the Head today. Ay, bedad.

 He turned to Dante and said:

 —You didn’t stir out at all, Mrs Riordan?

 Dante frowned and said shortly:

 —No.
